generate_noisy_or_topic_data: generate synthetic Noisy-OR topic model data with a given seed, number of topics, and number of words
evaluate_posterior_predictive_likelihood: evaluate the posterior predictive log-likelihood of test data against posterior samples from a Noisy-OR topic model
review_NoisyOrTopic_generate_data: review the NoisyOrTopic.generate_data method to understand how leak nodes, topic nodes, and word nodes are sampled
review_NoisyOrTopic_evaluate_posterior_p: review the NoisyOrTopic.evaluate_posterior_predictive method to understand how predictive log-likelihood is computed per sample
refactor_NoisyOrTopic_for_custom_fanout: refactor the NoisyOrTopic.generate_data method to support a custom average fanout distribution for topic children
